{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace EditContract

inductive EditKind where
  | boundary
  | overlap

inductive Result where
  | ok (text : String)
  | err (kind : EditKind) (index : Nat)

def utf16Len (s : String) : Nat :=
  s.length

def validBoundary (s : String) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  if i ≤ utf16Len s then true else false

def valid (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) : Bool :=
  let n := utf16Len text
  let rec check (i : Nat) (prevEnd : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i < edits.length then
      let (start, end, _) := edits.get! i
      if ¬ validBoundary text start then false
      else if ¬ validBoundary text end then false
      else if start < prevEnd then false
      else if start > end then false
      else check (i + 1) end
    else true
  check 0 0

def solve (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) : Result :=
  let n := utf16Len text
  let rec check (i : Nat) (prevEnd : Nat) : Result :=
    if i < edits.length then
      let (start, end, _) := edits.get! i
      if ¬ validBoundary text start then Result.err EditKind.boundary i
      else if ¬ validBoundary text end then Result.err EditKind.boundary i
      else if start < prevEnd then Result.err EditKind.overlap i
      else if start > end then Result.err EditKind.overlap i
      else check (i + 1) end
    else
      let rec apply (i : Nat) (acc : String) : String :=
        if i < edits.length then
          let (start, end, ins) := edits.get! i
          let before := acc.take start
          let after := acc.drop end
          let newAcc := before ++ ins ++ after
          apply (i + 1) newAcc
        else acc
      Result.ok (apply 0 text)
  check 0 0

def valid (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) : Prop :=
  let n := utf16Len text
  let rec check (i : Nat) (prevEnd : Nat) : Prop :=
    if i < edits.length then
      let (start, end, _) := edits.get! i
      validBoundary text start = true ∧ validBoundary text end = true ∧ start ≥ prevEnd ∧ start ≤ end ∧ check (i + 1) end
    else true
  check 0 0

theorem thm_boundary (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) (i : Nat) :
  i < edits.length →
  let (start, end, _) := edits.get! i
  (¬ validBoundary text start = true ∨ ¬ validBoundary text end = true) →
  solve text edits = Result.err EditKind.boundary i := by sorry

theorem thm_overlap (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) (i : Nat) :
  i < edits.length →
  (∀ j : Nat, j < i → let (s, e, _) := edits.get! j; validBoundary text s = true ∧ validBoundary text e = true ∧ s ≤ e) →
  let (start, end, _) := edits.get! i
  validBoundary text start = true ∧ validBoundary text end = true ∧ start ≤ end →
  let prevEnd := if i = 0 then 0 else (edits.get! (i - 1)).2.1 →
  start < prevEnd →
  solve text edits = Result.err EditKind.overlap i := by sorry

theorem thm_success (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) :
  valid text edits →
  ∃ (result : String), solve text edits = Result.ok result := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)), valid text edits ∧ solve text edits = Result.ok "" ∧
  ∃ (text2 : String) (edits2 : List (Nat × Nat × String)) (i : Nat), i < edits2.length ∧
  let (start, end, _) := edits2.get! i
  ¬ validBoundary text2 start = true ∧ solve text2 edits2 = Result.err EditKind.boundary i := by sorry

end EditContract",
